/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[funAgging]    Script Date: 11/2/2024 7:01:00 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funAgging]
(
	@Date DATE
)
RETURNS VARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Default to today if @Date is NULL
	SET @Date = ISNULL(@Date, GETDATE());

	DECLARE @Years INT = DATEDIFF(YEAR, @Date, GETDATE());
	DECLARE @Months INT = DATEDIFF(MONTH, DATEADD(YEAR, @Years, @Date), GETDATE());
	DECLARE @Days INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, DATEADD(MONTH, @Months, DATEADD(YEAR, @Years, @Date)), GETDATE());

	IF @Days < 0
	BEGIN
		SET @Months = @Months - 1;
		SET @Days = DATEDIFF(DAY, DATEADD(MONTH, @Months, DATEADD(YEAR, @Years, @Date)), GETDATE());
	END

	IF @Months < 0
	BEGIN
		SET @Years = @Years - 1;
		SET @Months = DATEDIFF(MONTH, DATEADD(YEAR, @Years, @Date), GETDATE());
		SET @Days = DATEDIFF(DAY, DATEADD(MONTH, @Months, DATEADD(YEAR, @Years, @Date)), GETDATE());
	END

	DECLARE @Length VARCHAR(100) = '';

	IF @Years > 0
		SET @Length = CONCAT(@Length, @Years, ' year', CASE WHEN @Years != 1 THEN 's ' ELSE ' ' END);

	IF @Months > 0
		SET @Length = CONCAT(@Length, @Months, ' month', CASE WHEN @Months != 1 THEN 's ' ELSE ' ' END);

	IF @Days > 0
		SET @Length = CONCAT(@Length, @Days, ' day', CASE WHEN @Days != 1 THEN 's' ELSE '' END);

	IF @Length = ''
		SET @Length = 'Today';

	SET @Length = RTRIM(@Length);

	RETURN @Length;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[funTaskPerProjectByUser]    Script Date: 11/2/2024 7:01:00 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funTaskPerProjectByUser]
(
	@Project int,
	@Enroll int
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	Declare @Count int
	set @Count=(SELECT isNull(count(*),0)
		  FROM ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTask t
		  inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTaskDetail d on t.intTaskID=d.intTaskID
		  where d.intUserID=@Enroll and t.intProjectID=@Project and d.intStatusID not in (5,6,7,8)
		  )
	return @count
END


GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[funUserAssigntoProject]    Script Date: 11/2/2024 7:01:00 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- select * from dbo.funUserAssigntoProject(10)
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funUserAssigntoProject]
(
	@Project int
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	Declare @Count int
	set @Count=(select Count(*) from [ProjectManagement].[dbo].[tblProjectAssign] where intProjectID=@Project and isActive=1)
	return @count
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetTask] 
	@TaskID int
AS
BEGIN
	select t.intTaskID, t.strTaskName, t.strDescription, t.strRequestFrom, td.tmWorking, CAST(DATEDIFF(DAY, t.dteCreated, GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR) + ' days ' + 
    CAST(DATEDIFF(HOUR, t.dteCreated, GETDATE()) % 24 AS VARCHAR) + ' hours' AS Agging, p.strProjectName
		from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTaskDetail td
		inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTask t on t.intTaskID=td.intTaskID
		inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProject p on p.intProjectID=t.intProjectID
		where t.intTaskID=@TaskID
		order by t.intTaskID
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[PerformanceReprot]    Script Date: 11/2/2024 7:01:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- EXEC PerformanceReprot '2024-6-1', '2024-9-1', 2, 0
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PerformanceReprot]
	@FromDate date,
	@ToDate date,
	@User int,
	@Project int
AS
BEGIN
	WITH CTE_ConvertedTime AS (
	SELECT
		intUserID,
		intTaskID,
		CAST(dteInsert AS DATE) AS dteInsertDate,
		DATEDIFF(SECOND, '00:00:00', tmWorking) AS WorkingSeconds
	FROM
		ProjectManagement.dbo.tblWorkLog
	WHERE
		CAST(dteInsert AS DATE) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
	),
	CTE_SumTime AS (
		SELECT
			intUserID,
			intTaskID,
			SUM(WorkingSeconds) AS TotalWorkingSeconds
		FROM
			CTE_ConvertedTime
		GROUP BY
			intUserID,
			intTaskID
	),
	CTE_TotalTime AS (
		SELECT
			SUM(TotalWorkingSeconds) AS TotalWorkingSecondsAll
		FROM
			CTE_SumTime
		WHERE
			intUserID = @User
	)
	SELECT 
		t.intTaskID,
		t.strTaskName,
		t.strDescription,
		t.strRequestFrom,
		p.strProjectName,
		CONVERT(TIME, DATEADD(SECOND, st.TotalWorkingSeconds, '00:00:00')) AS tmWorking,
		CAST(ROUND(100.0 * st.TotalWorkingSeconds / tt.TotalWorkingSecondsAll, 2) AS DECIMAL(5, 2)) AS WorkPercent
	FROM 
		ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTask t 
		INNER JOIN ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProject p ON p.intProjectID = t.intProjectID
		INNER JOIN CTE_SumTime st ON st.intTaskID = t.intTaskID 
		CROSS JOIN CTE_TotalTime tt
	WHERE 
		st.intUserID=@User and p.intProjectID = case when @Project=0 then p.intProjectID else @Project end
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[PerformanceReprotTeam]    Script Date: 11/2/2024 7:01:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- exec PerformanceReprotTeam 2, '2024-01-01', '2024-10-01'
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PerformanceReprotTeam]
	@User int,
	@FromDate date,
	@ToDate date
AS
BEGIN

	WITH CTE_ConvertedTime AS (
		SELECT
			intUserID,
			CAST(dteInsert AS DATE) AS dteInsertDate,
			DATEDIFF(SECOND, '00:00:00', tmWorking) AS WorkingSeconds
		FROM dbo.tblWorkLog
		WHERE CAST(dteInsert AS DATE) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
	),
	CTE_SumTime AS (
		SELECT
			intUserID,
			dteInsertDate,
			SUM(WorkingSeconds) AS TotalWorkingSeconds
		FROM CTE_ConvertedTime
		GROUP BY intUserID, dteInsertDate
	)
	select cast( ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dteInsertDate , u.intUserID) as int) as ID, cast(u.intUserID as int) as intUserID, u.strUserName , t.dteInsertDate, CONVERT(TIME, DATEADD(SECOND, t.TotalWorkingSeconds, '00:00:00')) AS tmWorking
	from CTE_SumTime t
	inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser u on u.intUserID=t.intUserID
	inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTeam tm on tm.intTeamID=u.intTeamID
	where tm.intUserID=@User
END

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprAssignUser]
	@User int,
	@Project int,
	@Active bit,
	@Enroll int,
	@Msg varchar(MAX) out
AS
BEGIN
	Declare @Details varchar(max)
	Declare @UserName varchar(MAX), @ProjectName varchar(MAX),  @Notify varchar(MAX)
	select top 1 @UserName=strUserName from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser where intUserID=@User
	select top 1 @ProjectName=strProjectName from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProject where intProjectID=@Project

	IF Exists(select * from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProjectAssign where intUserID=@User and intProjectID=@Project)
	Begin
		Declare @ActiveState bit= (select top 1 isActive from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProjectAssign where intUserID=@User and intProjectID=@Project)
		IF(@ActiveState!=@Active)
		Begin
			update ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProjectAssign set isActive=@Active where intUserID=@User and intProjectID=@Project
			IF(@Active = 0)
			Begin 
				set @Details='User -'+cast( @User as Varchar(50))+' Removed from Project -'+cast( @Project as Varchar(50))
				EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'Project Assign', @Details, @Enroll
				set @Msg=@UserName+' Removed form '+@ProjectName+' Successfully.'
				set @Notify ='You have been Removed from '+@ProjectName
				exec dbo.sprNotify @User, @Notify
			End
			Else
			Begin
				set @Details='User -'+cast( @User as Varchar(50))+' ReAssign To Project -'+cast( @Project as Varchar(50))
				EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'Project Assign', @Details, @Enroll
				set @Msg=@UserName+' ReAssign To '+@ProjectName+' Successfully.'
				set @Notify ='You have been ReAssign To '+@ProjectName
				exec dbo.sprNotify @User, @Notify
			End
		End
		else IF(@ActiveState=@Active)
		Begin
			set @Msg='Unprocess.'
		End
	End
	else IF not Exists(select * from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProjectAssign where intUserID=@User and intProjectID=@Project)
	Begin
		IF(@Active=1)
		Begin
			insert into ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProjectAssign (intUserID, intProjectID) 
			values (@User, @Project)
			set @Details='User -'+cast( @User as Varchar(50))+' Assign To Project -'+cast( @Project as Varchar(50))
			EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Insert', 'Project Assign', @Details, @Enroll
			set @Msg=@UserName+' Assign To '+@ProjectName+' Successfully.'
			set @Notify ='You have been Assign To '+@ProjectName
			exec dbo.sprNotify @User, @Notify
		End
		Else
		Begin
			set @Msg='Unprocess.' 
		End
	End
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
/*
declare @msg varchar(MAX)
exec sprCreateProject 'New Pyoourdtry6fdjttrtyrffoject',2,@msg OUTPUT
select @msg
*/
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprCreateProject]
	@Name Varchar(200),
	@Enroll int,
	@Msg varchar(MAX) out
AS
BEGIN
 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
	BEGIN TRY
		Declare @Team int= (select top 1 intTeamID FROM [ProjectManagement].[dbo].[tblTeam] where intUserID=@Enroll)
		if(@Team is not null)
		Begin
			IF not EXISTS ( SELECT [strProjectName] FROM [ProjectManagement].[dbo].[tblProject] where intTeamID=@Team and strProjectName=@Name)
			Begin
				insert into [ProjectManagement].[dbo].[tblProject] (strProjectName,intCreatedBy,intTeamID,dteCreated,isActive,isCompleate)
				values (@Name,@Enroll,@Team,GETDATE(),1,0)
				declare @Details varchar(MAX)='New Project Created'
				EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Insert', 'Project Create', @Details, @Enroll
				set @Msg='Project Created Successfully'
				Declare @Notify varchar(MAX) ='Project Created Successfully'
				exec dbo.sprNotify @Enroll, @Notify
			End
			else
			Begin
				set @Msg='Project already Exists!!!'
			End
		End
		Else
		Begin
			set @Msg='You are not authorized to perform this action!!!'
		End
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        set @Msg= 'An error occurred: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
    END CATCH;
END
GO

-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprcreateTask]
	@Name Varchar(max),
	@Description Varchar(max),
	@ReqFrom Varchar(max),
	@Enroll int,
	@Project int,
	@Msg varchar(MAX) out
AS
BEGIN
 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
	BEGIN TRY
	Declare @intPk int
	Insert into ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTask (strTaskName, strDescription, strRequestFrom, intUserID, intProjectID)
	values(@Name, @Description, @ReqFrom, @Enroll, @Project)
	set @intPk= SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	Insert into ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTaskDetail (intTaskID, intUserID, intStatusID, tmWorking)
	Values (@intPk, @Enroll, 2, '00:00:00')
	declare @Details varchar(MAX)='New Task Created ID - '+cast(@intPk as varchar(100))
	EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Insert', 'Task Create', @Details, @Enroll
	set @Msg='Task Created Successfully'
	Declare @Notify varchar(MAX) ='Task Created Successfully'
	exec dbo.sprNotify @Enroll, @Notify
COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        set @Msg= 'An error occurred: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
    END CATCH;
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sprGetCompleatedTask]    Script Date: 11/2/2024 7:01:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- exec ProjectManagement.dbo.sprGetCompleatedTask '2024-08-01' , '2024-09-05'
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprGetCompleatedTask]
	@FromDate DATE,
	@ToDate DATE
AS
BEGIN
    WITH CTE_ConvertedTime AS (
        SELECT
            intTaskID,
            MAX(CAST(dteInsert AS DATE)) AS dteInsertDate
        FROM
            ProjectManagement.dbo.tblWorkLog
        WHERE
            CAST(dteInsert AS DATE) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
        GROUP BY
            intTaskID
    )
	select t.intTaskID, t.strTaskName, t.strDescription, t.strRequestFrom, p.strProjectName, u.strUserName, tm.strTeamName, s.strStatus
	from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTask t
	inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProject p on p.intProjectID=t.intProjectID
	inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTaskDetail td on td.intTaskID=t.intTaskID
	inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser u on u.intUserID=td.intUserID
	inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTeam tm on tm.intTeamID=u.intTeamID
	inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblStatus s on s.intStatusID=td.intStatusID
	inner join CTE_ConvertedTime ct on ct.intTaskID=t.intTaskID
	where s.intStatusID in (5,6)
	order by intTaskID
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sprGetNotify]    Script Date: 11/2/2024 7:01:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprGetNotify]
	@Enroll int
AS
BEGIN
	Declare @Count int=15
	Declare @Temp table(ID int, Msg varchar(MAX), isNew bit)

	insert into @Temp
	SELECT TOP (@Count) intID, strMsg, 1
	FROM ProjectManagement.dbo.tblNotification
	where intUserID=@Enroll and isSent=0 or isSent= NULL
	order by intID desc

	Declare @RowCount int= (select count(*) from @Temp)

	if(@Count-@RowCount!=0)
	Begin
		insert into @Temp
		SELECT TOP (@Count-@RowCount) intID, strMsg, 0
		FROM ProjectManagement.dbo.tblNotification
		where intUserID=@Enroll and isSent=1
		order by intID desc
	End
	update ProjectManagement.dbo.tblNotification set isSent=1 where intID in (select ID from @Temp)
	select * from @Temp
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- Exec sprGetProjectByUser 2
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprGetProjectByUser]
	@User int,
	@Type int
AS
BEGIN
	IF(@Type=1)
	Begin
		select 0 as intProjectID,'All' as strProjectName, CAST(0 AS bit) as isCompleate, '0' as Lenght, '0' as UserCount, '0' as TaskCount
		UNION ALL
		select p.intProjectID,p.strProjectName, p.isCompleate, (SELECT dbo.funAgging(a.dteAssign)) as Lenght, (SELECT dbo.funUserAssigntoProject(p.intProjectID)) as UserCount, (SELECT dbo.funTaskPerProjectByUser(p.intProjectID, a.intUserID)) as TaskCount
		from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProjectAssign a 
		inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProject p on p.intProjectID=a.intProjectID
		where p.isActive=1 and a.isActive=1 and a.intUserID=@User
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		select p.intProjectID,p.strProjectName, p.isCompleate, (SELECT dbo.funAgging(a.dteAssign)) as Lenght, (SELECT dbo.funUserAssigntoProject(p.intProjectID)) as UserCount, (SELECT dbo.funTaskPerProjectByUser(p.intProjectID, a.intUserID)) as TaskCount
		from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProjectAssign a 
		inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProject p on p.intProjectID=a.intProjectID
		where p.isActive=1 and a.isActive=1 and a.intUserID=@User
	END
END

-- =============================================

-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- exec sprGetRequestList 2,1
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprGetRequestList]
	@Enroll int,
	@isSuperviser bit
AS
BEGIN
	if(@isSuperviser=0)
	Begin
		SELECT r.intID, u.strUserName, p.strProjectName, case when r.intStatusID=7 then 'Meeting' when r.intStatusID=8 then 'Emergency Support' else 'Undefined' end as 'Type', r.strTaskName, r.strDescription, r.strRequestFrom, r.dteCreated, r.strFrom, r.strTo, r.tmWorking
		FROM ProjectManagement.dbo.tblRequest r
		inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser u on u.intUserID=r.intUserID
		inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProject p  on p.intProjectID=r.intProjectID
		where u.intUserID=@Enroll and r.isAction is null
		order by r.intID
	End
	else if(@isSuperviser=1)
	Begin
		SELECT r.intID, u.strUserName, p.strProjectName, case when r.intStatusID=7 then 'Meeting' when r.intStatusID=8 then 'Emergency Support' else 'Undefined' end as 'Type', r.strTaskName, r.strDescription, r.strRequestFrom, r.dteCreated, r.strFrom, r.strTo, r.tmWorking
		FROM ProjectManagement.dbo.tblRequest r
		inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser u on u.intUserID=r.intUserID
		inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProject p  on p.intProjectID=r.intProjectID
		inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTeam t on t.intTeamID= u.intTeamID
		where t.intUserID=@Enroll and r.isAction is null
		order by u.strUserName, r.intID
	End
END

AS
BEGIN
	select u.intUserID, p.intProjectID, u.strUserName, ISNULL(a.isActive,0) as isActive
	from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProject p
	inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser u on u.intTeamID=p.intTeamID
	left join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProjectAssign a on a.intUserID=u.intUserID and a.intProjectID=p.intProjectID
	where p.intTeamID=@Team and p.intProjectID=@Project and u.isActive=1
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sprPendingReport]    Script Date: 11/2/2024 7:01:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- exec dbo.sprPendingReport 1
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprPendingReport]
	@User int
AS
BEGIN
	WITH CTE_ConvertedTime AS (
		SELECT
			intUserID,
			intTaskID,
			CAST(dteInsert AS DATE) AS dteInsertDate,
			DATEDIFF(SECOND, '00:00:00', tmWorking) AS WorkingSeconds
		FROM
			ProjectManagement.dbo.tblWorkLog
		),
		CTE_SumTime AS (
			SELECT
				intUserID,
				intTaskID,
				SUM(WorkingSeconds) AS TotalWorkingSeconds
			FROM
				CTE_ConvertedTime
			GROUP BY
				intUserID,
				intTaskID
		)
	select t.intTaskID, p.strProjectName, t.strTaskName, t.strDescription, s.strStatus, ISNULL(CONVERT(TIME, DATEADD(SECOND, sp.TotalWorkingSeconds, '00:00:00')), '00:00:00') AS tmWorking
	from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTask t 
	inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTaskDetail td on td.intTaskID=t.intTaskID
	inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblStatus s on s.intStatusID=td.intStatusID
	inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblProject p on p.intProjectID=t.intProjectID
	left join CTE_SumTime sp on sp.intTaskID=t.intTaskID and sp.intUserID=td.intUserID
	where td.intUserID=@User and s.intStatusID in (1,2,3,4)
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- exec [dbo].[sprRegistration] '13Subrato@akijbashir.com','New User','01779951164','NewUSer',1,0
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprRegistration]
	@user varchar(200),
	@Name varchar(200),
	@Phone varchar(20),
	@Key varchar(MAX),
	@team int,
	@Enroll int
AS
BEGIN
if(@user like '%_@__%.__%')
begin
	Begin try
	Begin Transaction
	DECLARE @Return TABLE (
		UserID INT,
		UserName VARCHAR(255),
		Phone VARCHAR(20),
		Email VARCHAR(255),
		TeamID INT,
		TeamName VARCHAR(255),
		ISBoss BIT,
		ISAdmin BIT,
		Token VARCHAR(255),
		Response VARCHAR(255));
	IF EXISTS(select * from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser where strEmail=@user)
	BEGIN
		Insert into @Return  Values(0,'Name','Phone','Email',0,0,0,0,'','User Already Exists !!!')
		--insert into @Return exec [dbo].[sprSecurityCheck] 0, 'Subrato@akijbashir.com','Test','1234' 
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		Declare @Userpass varbinary(max)= HASHBYTES('SHA2_512',@Key+cast('{Task}' as varchar(20)))
		Insert into ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser (strUserName,strPhone,strEmail,intTeamID,isActive,isAdmin)
		values (@Name,@Phone,@user,@team,1,0)
		Declare @UserID int=SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		insert into ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUserSecurity (intUserID,strKey,dteValidTo,intFailedAttamped)
		values (@UserID,@Userpass,DATEADD(MONTH,1,GETDATE()),0)
		DECLARE @Details varchar(MAX) = 'User Enlisted USer ID-' + CAST(@UserID AS VARCHAR(50));
		set @Enroll=CASE WHEN @Enroll = 0 THEN @UserID ELSE CAST(@Enroll AS NVARCHAR(50)) END;
		EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Insert', 'User Registrassion', @Details, @Enroll
		insert into @Return exec [dbo].[sprSecurityCheck] 0, @user,@Key,'1234' 
		Declare @Notify varchar(MAX) ='WellCome to Project Management'
		exec dbo.sprNotify @Enroll, @Notify
	END
	Commit
	Select * From @Return
	End try
	Begin Catch
		Rollback
		Insert into @Return  Values(0,'Name','Phone','Email',0,0,0,0,'','DB_Error:'+ ERROR_MESSAGE())
		select * from @Return
	End Catch
END
END
GO

GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprRequetAction]
	@RequestID int,
	@Enroll int,
	@Type int,
	@Msg varchar(MAX) out
AS
BEGIN
 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
	BEGIN TRY
	declare @Details varchar(max)
	Declare @Notify varchar(MAX), @TaskName varchar(MAX)
	set @TaskName =(select top 1 strTaskName from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblRequest where intID=@RequestID)
	if(@Type=1)
	Begin

		insert into ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTask (strTaskName, strDescription, strRequestFrom, intUserID, dteCreated, intProjectID)
		select strTaskName, strDescription, strRequestFrom, intUserID, dteCreated, intProjectID 
		from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblRequest where intID=@RequestID

		Declare @TaskID int=SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		insert into ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTaskDetail (intTaskID ,intUserID ,intStatusID ,tmWorking)
		select  @TaskID, intUserID, intStatusID, tmWorking 
		from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblRequest where intID=@RequestID


		insert into ProjectManagement.dbo.tblWorkLog (dteInsert, intUserID, tmWorking, intStatusID, intTaskID)
		select  dteCreated, intUserID, tmWorking, intStatusID, @TaskID
		from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblRequest where intID=@RequestID

		update ProjectManagement.dbo.tblRequest set isAction=1, dteAction=GETDATE(), intTaskID=@TaskID where intID=@RequestID

		set @Details='Request Approved ID - '+cast(@RequestID as varchar(100))
		EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Insert & Update', 'Request Approve', @Details, @Enroll
		
		set @Msg='Request Approved Successfully'
		set @Notify = @TaskName+' Request have been approved.'
		exec dbo.sprNotify @Enroll, @Notify

	End
	else if(@Type=2)
	Begin

		update ProjectManagement.dbo.tblRequest set isAction=0, dteAction=GETDATE() where intID=@RequestID

		set @Details='Request Reject ID - '+cast(@RequestID as varchar(100))
		EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'Request Reject', @Details, @Enroll
		set @Msg='Request Rejected Successfully'
		set @Notify = @TaskName+' Request have been Rejected.'
		exec dbo.sprNotify @Enroll, @Notify
	End
	else
	Begin
		set @Msg='Sorry There wasn an error!!!'
	End
COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        set @Msg= 'An error occurred: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
    END CATCH;
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sprSecurityCheck]    Script Date: 11/2/2024 7:01:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
--exec [dbo].[sprSecurityCheck] 2,'subrato@akijbashir.com','Sub@2024','mMEAku'
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprSecurityCheck] 
	@type int,
	@Email varchar(200),
	@password varchar(200),
	@code Varchar(200)
AS
BEGIN
if(@Email like '%_@__%.__%')
begin
	Begin try
	Begin Transaction
	DECLARE @Return TABLE (
		UserID INT,
		UserName VARCHAR(255),
		Phone VARCHAR(20),
		Email VARCHAR(255),
		TeamID INT,
		TeamName VARCHAR(255),
		ISBoss BIT,
		ISAdmin BIT,
		Token VARCHAR(255),
		Response VARCHAR(255));
	declare @count int,@UserID int
	if exists( select 1 from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser where strEmail= @Email) 
	Begin 
		set @count= (select count(*) from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser where strEmail= @Email)
		IF(@count!=1)
		Begin
			insert into @Return values(0,'Name','Phone','Email',0,'Team',0,0,'','Invalid Credantial')
		End
		else
		Begin
			Set @UserID=(select top 1 intUserID from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser where strEmail= @Email)
			IF exists(select 1 from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser where intUserID= @UserID and isActive=0)
			Begin
				insert into @Return values(0,'Name','Phone','Email',0,'Team',0,0,'','Sorry, you are no longer authorized to access this service')
			End
			Else 
			Begin
				IF(@type=0) --LogIn
			Begin
				IF((select top 1 dteValidTo from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUserSecurity where intUserID=@UserID)<GETDATE())
				BEGIN
					insert into @Return values(0,'Name','Phone','Email',0,'Team',0,0,'','Password Expaired !!!')
				END
				ELSE IF((select top 1 isLocked from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUserSecurity where intUserID=@UserID)=1)
				BEGIN
					insert into @Return values(0,'Name','Phone','Email',0,'Team',0,0,'','Your Account is locked !!!')
				END
				Else
				Begin
					Declare @Userpass varbinary(max)= HASHBYTES('SHA2_512',@password+cast('{Task}' as varchar(20)) )
					Declare @DBpass varbinary(max) = isnull((select top (1) strKey from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUserSecurity where intUserID = @UserID ), cast('NDOTP' as varbinary))
					IF(@Userpass!=@DBpass)
					Begin 
						Update  ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUserSecurity set intFailedAttamped=intFailedAttamped+1 where intUserID=@UserID
						insert into @Return values(0,'Name','Phone','Email',0,'Team',0,0,'','Invalid Credantial')
					End
					Else
					Begin
						insert into @Return 
						select u.intUserID, u.strUserName, u.strPhone, u.strEmail, t.intTeamID, t.strTeamName, case when t.intUserID=u.intUserID then 1 else 0 end, u.isAdmin, '', 'GO'
						from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser u
						inner join ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTeam t on t.intTeamID=u.intTeamID
						where u.intUserID=@UserID
					End
				End
			End
			Else IF(@type=1)
			Begin
				DECLARE @Key VARCHAR(50)
				SET @Key = ''
				SELECT TOP 6 @Key = @Key + [char]
					FROM [dbo].[tblRandomCharsHelper]
					ORDER BY NEWID()
				Insert Into ProjectManagement.dbo.tblSecurityCheck (intUserID,strOTP) values(@UserID,@Key)
				insert into @Return values(0,'Name','Phone','Email',0,'Team',0,0,'','Otp send to :'+(select top 1 strPhone from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser where intUserID= @UserID))
				EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Insert', 'OTP Request', 'OTP Request', @UserID
			End
			Else IF(@type=2)
			Begin
				Declare @OTP varchar(20),@intOtpId int
				select top 1 @OTP=strOTP, @intOtpId=intId from  ProjectManagement.dbo.tblSecurityCheck where intUserID=@UserID and GETDATE() between dteInsertTime and dteExpTime and isUsed=0 order by intId desc
				IF(@OTP=@code)
				Begin
					Declare @pass varbinary(max)= HASHBYTES('SHA2_512',@password+cast('{Task}' as varchar(20)) )
					Update ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUserSecurity set strKey=@pass, dteValidTo=DATEADD(MONTH,1,GETDATE()) where intUserID=@UserID
					Update ProjectManagement.dbo.tblSecurityCheck set isUsed=1 where intId=@intOtpId
					EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'Password Reset', 'Password Reset Successfully', @UserID
					insert into @Return values(0,'Name','Phone','Email',0,'Team',0,0,'','Password Updated Successfully')
				End
				Else
				Begin
					insert into @Return values(0,'Name','Phone','Email',0,'Team',0,0,'','Otp dose not Match !!!')
				End
			End
			END
		End
	End
	Else
	Begin
		insert into @Return values(0,'Name','Phone','Email',0,'Team',0,0,'','Invalid Credantial')
	End
	Commit
	select * from @Return
	End try
	Begin Catch
		Rollback
		Insert into @Return (Response) Values('DB_Error:'+ ERROR_MESSAGE())
		select * from @Return
	End Catch
END
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprtaskManager]
	@Type int,
	@TaskID int,
	@User int,
	@Status int,
	@tmTime time,
	@Enroll int,
	@Msg varchar(MAX) out
AS
BEGIN
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
	BEGIN TRY

	Declare @Details varchar(max)
	Declare @NewTime time = (select top 1 tmWorking from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTaskDetail where intTaskID=@TaskID)
	set @NewTime= convert(time,convert(datetime,@NewTime)+convert(datetime,@tmTime))
	IF(@Type=0) --Status and time Update
	Begin
		if exists(select * from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTaskDetail where intStatusID=1 and intUserID=@Enroll and intTaskID!=@TaskID)
		Begin
			set @Msg='Please finish the current task at hand!!!'
		End
		Else
		Begin
			Update  ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTaskDetail set tmWorking=@NewTime, intStatusID=@Status where intTaskID=@TaskID
			exec ProjectManagement.dbo.sprWorkLog @Enroll, @tmTime, @Status, @TaskID
			set @Details='Task Status Change ID- '+cast(@TaskID as varchar(100))
			EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'Status and Time Change', @Details, @Enroll
			set @Msg='Status Updated Successfully.'
		End
	End
	Else IF(@Type=1) --Transfer and time Update
	Begin
		Update  ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTaskDetail set tmWorking=@NewTime, intStatusID=2, intUserID=@User where intTaskID=@TaskID
		exec ProjectManagement.dbo.sprWorkLog @Enroll, @tmTime, 2, @TaskID
		set @Details='Task Transfer ID- '+cast(@TaskID as varchar(100))+' Transfer to -'+cast(@User as varchar(100))
		EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'Status, Transfer and Time Change', @Details, @Enroll
		set @Msg='Task Transfer Successfully.'
		Declare @TaskName varchar(500)=(select top 1 strTaskName from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTask where intTaskID=@TaskID)
		Declare @Notify varchar(MAX) =@TaskName+' Transfered to you.'
		exec dbo.sprNotify @User, @Notify
	End

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        set @Msg= 'An error occurred: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
    END CATCH;
END

GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprUpdateProjectStatus]
	@Type int,
	@intProject int,
	@Enroll int,
	@Msg varchar(MAX) out
AS
BEGIN
 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
	BEGIN TRY
	Declare @Details varchar(MAX)
	IF(@Type=0)
	Begin
		Update [ProjectManagement].[dbo].[tblProject] set isActive=0 where intProjectID=@intProject
		set @Details ='Project - '+cast( @intProject as Varchar(50))+' is being inactive'
		EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'Project Active Status updated to 0', @Details, @Enroll
		set @Msg='Project Removed Successfully!!!'
	End
	else IF(@Type=1)
	Begin
		Declare @ststus bit= (select isCompleate from [ProjectManagement].[dbo].[tblProject] where intProjectID=@intProject)
		Declare @Updatedststus bit
		if(@ststus=1)
		Begin 
			set @Updatedststus=0
		End
		else 
		Begin 
			set @Updatedststus=1
		End
		Update [ProjectManagement].[dbo].[tblProject] set isCompleate=@Updatedststus where intProjectID=@intProject
		set @Details ='Project - '+cast( @intProject as Varchar(50))+' compleate status is being -'+cast( @Updatedststus as Varchar(50))
		EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'Project Compleate Status updated' , @Details, @Enroll
		set @Msg='Project Updated Successfully!!!'
	End
	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        set @Msg= 'An error occurred: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
    END CATCH;
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sprUpdateUser]    Script Date: 11/2/2024 7:01:03 PM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
/*
 declare @Output varchar(200)
 exec sprUpdateUser 22,'Subrato Sarker','01779951167','22Subrato@akijbashir.com',1,1,0,2,1, @Output output
 select @Output
 */
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprUpdateUser] 
	
	@User int,
	@Name varchar(200),
	@Phone varchar(20),
	@Email varchar(200),
	@TeamiID int,
	@isActive bit,
	@isBoss bit,
	@Enroll int,
	@Locked bit,
	@Msg varchar(MAX) out
AS
BEGIN
 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
	BEGIN TRY
	set @Msg='Sorry there was nothing to change.'
	Declare @Details varchar(max)
	Declare @UName varchar(max), @UPhone varchar(max), @UEmail varchar(max), @UTeam int
	Declare @Notify varchar(MAX)
	if(@isBoss=1)
	Begin
		Declare @Sup int
		select top 1 @Sup=intUserID from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTeam where intTeamID=@TeamiID
		IF(@Sup!=@User)
		Begin
			Declare @TeamName varchar(500), @PreSup int
			select top 1 @TeamName= strTeamName, @PreSup=intUserID from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTeam where intTeamID=@TeamiID
			set @Notify  ='Superviser have been change of '+@TeamName
			exec dbo.sprNotify @PreSup, @Notify

			set @Details= 'Superviser is being change of Team- '+cast(@TeamiID as varchar(100))+', New Superviser is '+cast(@User as varchar(100))+' form ' +cast(@Sup as varchar(100))+'.'
			update ProjectManagement.dbo.tblTeam set intUserID=@User where intTeamID=@TeamiID
			EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'Superviser Change', @Details, @Enroll
			set @Msg='Superviser Changed Successfully.'

			set @Notify  ='Congratulation, '+@TeamName+' have been assigned to you'
			exec dbo.sprNotify @User, @Notify
		End
	End
	IF(@isActive=0)
	Begin
		update ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser set isActive=0 where intUserID=@User
		EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'User Inactive', 'User Inactive', @Enroll
		set @Msg='User Deactive Successfully.'
	End
	select top 1 @UName=strUserName, @UPhone=strPhone, @UEmail=strEmail, @UTeam=intTeamID from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser where intUserID=@User
	IF(@UName!=@Name or @UPhone!=@Phone or @UEmail!=@Email or @UTeam!=@TeamiID)
	Begin
		set @Details= 'Update User - '+cast(@User as varchar(100))+'. strUserName-'+@UName+' strPhone-'+@UPhone+' strEmail-'+@UEmail+' Team-'+cast(@UTeam as varchar(100))+'.strUserName-'+@Name+' strPhone-'+@Phone+' strEmail-'+@Email+' Team-'+cast(@TeamiID as varchar(100))
		update ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUser set strUserName=@Name, strPhone=@Phone, strEmail=@Email, intTeamID=@TeamiID where intUserID=@User
		EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'User Update', @Details, @Enroll
		set @Msg='User Updated Successfully.'

		set @Notify  ='Your information have been updated.'
		exec dbo.sprNotify @User, @Notify
	End
	Declare @PreLock bit =(select top 1 isLocked from ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUserSecurity where intUserID=@User)
	if(@PreLock!=@Locked)
	Begin
		Update ProjectManagement.dbo.tblUserSecurity set intFailedAttamped=0 where intUserID=@User
		set @Details= 'User Unlocked ID-'+cast(@User as varchar(100))
		EXEC ProjectManagement.dbo.sprLog 'Update', 'UnLocked', @Details, @Enroll
		set @Msg='User UnLocked Successfully.'

		set @Notify  ='Your account has been unlocked.'
		exec dbo.sprNotify @User, @Notify
	End

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        set @Msg= 'An error occurred: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
    END CATCH;
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sprWorkLog]
	@Enroll int,
	@TmWorking Time,
	@Status int,
	@Task int
AS
BEGIN
		INSERT INTO ProjectManagement.dbo.tblWorkLog (intUserID, tmWorking, intStatusID, intTaskID)
		values (@Enroll, @TmWorking, @Status, @Task)
END
